verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for a developer tool with a CLI and Agent SDK, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions API versions, version pinning, or a deprecation policy. The ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and Agent SDK items describe authentication and building blocks, not versioning guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
